properties.title: Glider CHLA profile metrics (0–200 m, 10 m bins) with PACE matchups
properties.description:
CHLA metrics from 280 IOOS Glider DAC deployments (Slocum, Spray and Seagliders; Mar 2024–Oct 2026; US East and West coasts, British Columbia, Gulf of Alaska, Irminger Sea, Bermuda, Great Lakes, Antarctic Peninsula; column region), chosen by a scan of every DAC chlorophyll deployment, one row per deployment and 3 h window of local solar time keeping one glider profile per window, depth-binned 0–200 m in 10 m bins (A < depth <= B) from samples passing the dataset's QC flag, and divided by the Sauzède et al. fluorescence:chlorophyll ratio (column chla_ratio), as for OOI. The raw fluorometer bins (CHLA_FLUOR_A_B) and a deep (dark) offset (dark_offset, not subtracted) are kept as columns. QC columns from the scan: deep_offset_flag (True for deployments reading > 0.2 below 300 m, mostly California Current Sprays; drop with df[~df.deep_offset_flag]) and scan_check (notes such as 'jumpy surface' or 'sparse depths', empty when the deployment passed). Windows with a whole-column sensor failure were removed. Source: IOOS Glider DAC ERDDAP. Matched to PACE OCI Level-3 4 km Daily V3.2 Rrs (PACE_OCI_L3M_AOP), chlor_a (PACE_OCI_L3M_BGC) and Kd_490 (PACE_OCI_L3M_KD, band 489.674 nm): a profile matches a granule when its time is within 24 h after the granule's time_coverage_start, at the nearest 4 km cell; standard files are used before NRT. Only profiles with a matching Rrs granule are kept; Rrs is NaN where the pixel was masked (cloud, glint).

How to load

ASSET_URL use 'Copy URL' on left

Python df = pandas.read_parquet('ASSET_URL')

R  df <- arrow::read_parquet('ASSET_URL')
properties.platform: IOOS Glider DAC gliders (Slocum, Spray, Seaglider)
